WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS addr_count
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(addr_count) AS total
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT 
  cc.city_id,
  cc.addr_count,
  CAST(cc.addr_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total AS division_result
FROM city_counts cc
CROSS JOIN total_count tc
WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY division_result DESC
LIMIT 10
